Header: In Sinhala: PathrasihinVimerogaya; in Tamil-“Kaththarisittilainoi Kuruvichchai; CAUSE: Phytoplasma. VECTORS: leafhoppers such as Empoasca devastans

Prevention: Eradication of volunteer crops/plants previous season and
Solanaceous weeds that can carry the disease.
In northern province, plant brinjal in late
July in order to avoid high populations of the vectors
Use good pest management practices to conserve the natural enemies such as lace wing, damsel bug, minute pirate bug
Chilli) to prevent build-up of the vectors
Monitoring: Observe for small leaves and short internodes at top
Visit daily and observe the mobility of green hoppers
Observe under surface of the leaves for vectors
Restrictions: Avoid drinking, eating and smoking during the spray
Use safety measures i.e. gloves, cloths, gum boots, masks and goggles while handling and spraying the pesticides
III; Neonicotinoid pesticide; Contact & Systemic action; Very toxic to aquatic organisms
No of sprays per season not more than two; Slightly toxic to predatory mites and other beneficial
II; Use protective clothing when applying; Systemic
